content.text: I've reviewed the grant, restrictions, maintenance, fees, and general provisions. No exclusivity binding our side exists.

input.quote: Garman hereby grants to Sparkling, for the use of Sparkling and affiliated companies of Sparkling operating at Authorized Locations, a non-transferable and non-exclusive licence to use: (i) the Software, safely in executable object code format, at each AS400 at each of the Authorized Locations; and (ii) the Documentation.
input.rationale: No exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation is imposed on Sparkling (Customer). The only uses of "exclusive" are (i) the non-exclusive licence grant in Section 2 (p0028), (ii) the "exclusive remedy" limitation in Section 15 (p0105), (iii) the non-exclusive escrow licence in Section 16 (p0115), and (iv) non-exclusive jurisdiction in the general provisions (p0146) — none of which restrict our freedom to source from other suppliers. The restrictions on Sparkling in Section 3 (p0030-p0037) are limited to copying, assignment, reverse engineering and scope-of-use covenants, with no covenant against procuring competing software or services from third parties. Maintenance and Support (Section 10, p0065 et seq.) obliges Garman to provide services on a renewable one-year term but does not require Sparkling to source support, Improvements or future modules solely from Garman, and Fees (Section 11, p0084) contains no minimum-purchase or requirements commitment. Searches for "sole", "requirements", "purchase", "procure", "supplier", "competing" and "exclusivity" returned no exclusive-dealing language. The Agreement therefore meets the preferred position and no redline is needed.
